issues: Two harmless 401 console errors from /auth/me on unauthenticated first paint (AuthContext bootstrap). Cosmetic only; could be suppressed by not calling /auth/me if no token in localStorage.

critical_code_review_comments: auth: bcrypt hash format $2b$ (bcrypt.hashpw + gensalt) - correct; httpOnly cookies set with secure+samesite=none on login/register/refresh; brute-force lockout at 5 attempts / 15min implemented in /api/auth/login (identifier=ip:email) - matches playbook.
seed_admin() updates password_hash if ADMIN_PASSWORD changed - idempotent - correct.
AuthContext calls /auth/me on mount even without a token, causing a benign 401 in console. Guard with `if (localStorage.getItem('nexus_token'))` to remove noise.
chat_routes stream endpoint properly serialises SSE with 'data: ...\n\n' frames and sends meta/token/done/error types matching the frontend parser.
document_routes /documents/{doc_id} response excludes MongoDB _id everywhere; good.
generator.stream_answer falls back to Emergent universal LLM key when Ollama is unreachable - flagged explicitly in /system/status - matches spec.
No files >700 lines; async/await used across DB/IO; env-vars used everywhere (no hardcoded URLs); Pydantic v2 validators on register/login/settings; data-testids present throughout UI.
test_credentials: admin@nexusrag.ai / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test users created dynamically with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: One transient PDF (TEST_bluefin_*) uploaded and bulk-deleted during backend tests; another PDF uploaded via UI ingested to admin's 'default' collection (left in place; safe). Pre-existing 'demo' collection with 3 PDFs + 1 image + 1 additional image was used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs healthy under supervisor at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Emergent LLM key streams claude-sonnet-4-6; single chat turn ~26s (embed ~23s cold, generate ~3.7s). Chroma persists at /app/backend/data/chroma. Frontend cold first-load requires ~5-15s before React mounts; use wait_for_selector with 45s timeout for the first page.
